runtimeResult.message: Headless execution requires clarification before a repository plan can be created.

promptUnderstanding.reply: I need a design direction before making the calculator theme better. Please choose the intended visual style.
promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The user requested a calculator theme improvement limited to styles.css, with .env, .git/**, and bun.lock protected. No design direction has been confirmed. If execution proceeds, bun test should be run when appropriate.

deliverables: A scoped theme update in styles.css.
constraints: Do not modify .env, .git/**, bun.lock, or any other file.
Run bun test when execution is appropriate.
Do not infer a material design direction without confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: The calculator theme follows the confirmed design direction.
bun test is run when appropriate and its result is reported.

questions.prompt: Which visual direction should the calculator theme use?
questions.rationale: The requested improvement is subjective, and the prompt explicitly prohibits guessing a material design direction.

options.label: Modern neutral
options.description: Use a clean, restrained interface with balanced contrast and subtle depth.

options.label: Dark premium
options.description: Use a polished dark interface with richer surfaces and high-contrast controls.

options.label: Playful bright
options.description: Use a more expressive palette with colorful controls and stronger visual personality.
